notes.title: Achievements Hotfix
notes.notes:
v0.10

[list]
[*]Wonder Vision Achievement Update
[/list]

If you were unable to receive the Wonder Vision achievement previously,  simply replay any game mode without using hints.

notes.title: So Much Stuff 2 - Now Available!
notes.notes:
Get ready to clear out hidden items and trinkets in the most fun and addictive way possible! Our new game "So Much Stuff 2" is out today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43908289/50d4e1d9f596280fe4acaa4e2799b9c1f709cd2a.gif[/img]

Explore beautifully arranged themes such as 50s Diners, Groceries, Fancy Jewelry, Science Laboratory, and many more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43908289/ad4555dd017e04872abf6a88aa24ac60f95e38b0.gif[/img]

Get your hands on "So Much Stuff 2" today and get lost in the thrill of finding hidden objects and trinkets!
